AL.known: The Saturn V at Huntsville, Vulcan over Birmingham, and the Gulf at Mobile.

AK.known: Denali, glaciers calving into the sea, moose in the willows and the aurora overhead.

AZ.known: The Grand Canyon, Monument Valley buttes, Hoover Dam and saguaro country around Phoenix.

AR.known: Ozark ridges, the bathhouses of Hot Springs, and the only public diamond mine in the country.

CA.known: The Golden Gate, Half Dome, redwoods, the Hollywood sign and surf down the whole coast.

CO.known: The Maroon Bells, Red Rocks, Denver's skyline and ski lifts climbing fourteener country.

CT.known: Hartford's gold dome, Yale's gothic towers, Mystic's tall ships and the Sound.

DE.known: Dover's Legislative Hall, Cape Henlopen Light and the Rehoboth boardwalk umbrellas.

DC.known: The Capitol, the Washington Monument, Lincoln and Jefferson, the White House and the cherry blossoms.

FL.known: Shuttles off the Cape, Miami art deco, Everglades airboats, flamingos, orange groves and the old capitol.

HI.known: Kilauea's lava, Diamond Head, Honolulu, surfboards on the sand and a rainbow most afternoons.

ID.known: The Sawtooths, Shoshone Falls on the Snake, Boise, and yes, the potato.

IL.known: Chicago: the Willis Tower, the Hancock, the Bean and Navy Pier, with Lincoln's Springfield and corn beyond.

IA.known: The Field of Dreams, the American Gothic house, red barns, turbines and corn to the horizon.

KS.known: Sunflowers and wheat, Monument Rocks in the west, the Flint Hills and Topeka's dome.

KY.known: Churchill Downs' twin spires, the Louisville Slugger, horse farms and white fences.

LA.known: The Superdome and St. Louis Cathedral, riverboats, cypress bayous, pelicans and the capitol tower in Baton Rouge.

ME.known: Portland Head Light, lobster boats, Katahdin and pines to the Canadian line.

MD.known: The Bay Bridge, blue crabs, the flag over Fort McHenry, Annapolis and Baltimore's harbor.

MA.known: Boston's Hancock and Pru, the Zakim Bridge, Fenway, Plymouth's Mayflower and Cape Cod Light.

MI.known: The Mackinac Bridge, Detroit's Renaissance Center, Sleeping Bear Dunes and cherry country.

MN.known: Spoonbridge and Cherry, Paul Bunyan and Babe, Split Rock Light and ten thousand lakes.

MS.known: Riverboats on the Mississippi, Delta blues guitars, magnolias and the Biloxi Light.

MO.known: The Gateway Arch over the Mississippi, Kansas City's skyline, riverboats and the Ozarks.

MT.known: Glacier's peaks, bison on the range, Flathead Lake and more sky than anywhere.

NE.known: Chimney Rock, Carhenge, the Sandhills and corn around Lincoln's capitol tower.

NV.known: The Strip at night, Hoover Dam, Lake Tahoe, Reno and a lot of beautiful empty desert.

NH.known: Mount Washington's summit observatory, covered bridges, Winnipesaukee and fall maples.

NJ.known: Lady Liberty in the harbor, the boardwalk and Ferris wheel, Barnegat Light, the Pine Barrens and farm stands.

NM.known: Balloons over Albuquerque, adobe pueblos, Shiprock, White Sands and red chile ristras.

NY.known: Manhattan's skyline and the Brooklyn Bridge, Niagara Falls, the Adirondacks, the Finger Lakes and Albany.

NC.known: Hatteras Light, the Wright Flyer at Kitty Hawk, the Blue Ridge and the Biltmore.

ND.known: The world's largest buffalo at Jamestown, the Badlands, wheat and the capitol tower in Bismarck.

OH.known: The Rock and Roll Hall of Fame and Key Tower, Cedar Point's coasters, Columbus and Cincinnati.

OK.known: Devon Tower, pumpjacks and derricks, wind farms on red dirt and Route 66.

OR.known: Mount Hood, Crater Lake, Haystack Rock, Portland and Douglas firs everywhere.

PA.known: Philadelphia's City Hall and the Liberty Bell, Pittsburgh's glass castle and yellow bridges, the Poconos and Amish farms.

RI.known: The Newport Bridge, Gilded Age mansions, Narragansett Bay sailboats and Providence.

SC.known: The Ravenel Bridge, Rainbow Row, palmettos, the Angel Oak and Myrtle Beach.

SD.known: The Black Hills, Badlands buttes, bison and the Corn Palace at Mitchell.

TN.known: Nashville's Batman Building, the Memphis Pyramid and Beale Street guitars, and the Smokies.

TX.known: The Alamo, the pink granite capitol in Austin, Reunion Tower, Houston, pumpjacks and the Gulf.

UT.known: Delicate Arch, the Bonneville Salt Flats, the Wasatch ski slopes, the Great Salt Lake and Monument Valley.

VT.known: Maple sugar shacks, covered bridges, Holsteins, the Green Mountains and Lake Champlain.

VA.known: Monticello, Richmond, the Blue Ridge, colonial Williamsburg and the Chesapeake shore.

WA.known: The Space Needle, Rainier, Mount St. Helens, ferries on the Sound, apple orchards and the Palouse.

WV.known: The New River Gorge Bridge, whitewater below it, the gold-domed capitol and ridges in every direction.

WI.known: Milwaukee's Calatrava wings, cheese, dairy barns, Door County lights and lake country.

WY.known: Devils Tower, the Tetons, Old Faithful, bison on open range and Cheyenne.
